reason: Ran the 5-step smoke test: open Gamut, open agent QA-20261127-231918-8kd2, send the "Example Domain" browser prompt, wait for the reply, verify it.
steps: Step 1: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Gamut home loaded with the QA-20261127-231918-8kd2 and QA-20261127-231917-hsdi agents listed in the sidebar.
Step 2: Clicked QA-20261127-231918-8kd2 in the sidebar — agent page opened with an empty message input and the agent shown as idle.

Step 3: Typed "Open a browser and go to https://example.com. Tell me the page title." and pressed Enter — the text stayed in the input and Enter added a blank line, so nothing was sent. Clicked the Send button — a session "Browser Page Title Check" started, the prompt appeared in the chat, and the agent went to "working". This is consistent with the input's "Press cmd+enter to send" hint, so I did not log it as a bug.
Step 4: Waited up to 3 minutes for "Example Domain" to appear — the reply appeared within seconds, the agent returned to idle, and the turn showed "Worked for 4s · 3 tool calls".
Step 5: Verified the response — it reads 'The page title is "Example Domain". The page loaded normally, and I closed the browser afterwards.' Took a screenshot showing the response in the chat.
